item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
Humdrum v0.2.0

  • docs: README accuracy pass + auto-generate release notes
  • fix(mutter): PTT reliability — long holds, races, finalize feedback
  • Mutter: PTT to Carbon, pause/escape, diagnostics, corrections, wake re-warm
  • Mutter: push-to-talk activation mode
  • Mutter: pause (⌥P) and escape-to-cancel with red flash
  • Diff-paste at phase 1, keep listening through phase 2
  • feat(mutter): orb polish — phase-1 commit, speech-gated dots, breathing
  • chore: adversarial review notes from overnight pass
  • feat(mutter): pivot to commit-once paste cadence
  • feat: accumulated UI + state polish since v0.2.0
  • feat(core): add FuzzyMatcher utility with tests
  • chore: refresh app icon assets and generator
  • Flip paste cascade to clipboard-first; fix pastedText advance bug; restore recorder drag
  • v0.2.0 rebuild: HumdrumCore library + keystroke-first paste cascade
  • Add Sparkle config to Info.plist
  • Rename to Humdrum; add auto-save, move-to-Applications, notarized release pipeline
  • Initial commit: MeetingScribe app

Full Changelog: https://github.com/aaronjellis/Humdrum/commits/v0.2.0
